# CustomSongMe

> CustomSongMe creates personalized custom songs for any occasion — written, produced, and delivered by one person, Dan ("Dan the Song Man"), using AI-assisted music tools under his direct creative direction. Every song starts from the customer's own story.

## What we offer

- **Complete (Public) — $50**: downloadable MP3, public YouTube video with shareable link, cover art image, lyric sheet image. Video is posted to the CustomSongMe YouTube channel.
- **Complete (Unlisted) — $75**: same deliverables, but the video is unlisted (link-only, not published to the channel).
- **MP3 Only — $30**: downloadable MP3 audio file only.
- **Business Jingles — $100**: same deliverables as Complete, for businesses.
- **Adopt a Rescue Dog songs**: completely free, no payment required — a custom song to help a shelter dog get adopted.

## How it works

Customers submit their story and preferences through an order form, pay upfront, and Dan personally reviews and produces each song during studio hours (Mon–Fri 9am–6pm PT, Sat 10am–2pm PT), typically delivering within 24 hours of confirmed payment. Every order is backed by a Personal Happiness Guarantee: Dan revises until it's right, or refunds in full.
